export_evidence: No export bill-of-lading record found. The only customs dataset retrieved is inbound: ImportKey page for slug 'harman-international-india-private-limited' shows 'Total Shipments 80396 Records detected' with rows such as '2026-02-28 | HARMAN INTERNATIONAL (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED | HARMAN AUTOMOTIVE ELECTRONIC | ... | DIGHI ICD INDIG6, India | Shanghai, CHINA | 85411000 | 1112824' — i.e. origin China, destination India, HS 85411000, B/L 1112824. Every one of the 5 rows actually displayed on that page is an IMPORT into India (origin Shanghai/Wuhan/Dalian, destination Dighi ICD / Nhava Sheva). Zero export rows were seen. Source counter: page claims 80,396 shipments; rows actually inspected = 5, all imports.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, or annual-report India revenue split could be retrieved. Zaubacorp, TheCompanyCheck, Eximpedia and Volza all returned HTTP 403; InstaFinancials returned only its generic product landing page with no company-specific financials. Domestic supply activity is therefore not confirmed and not refuted — null, not public in the sources reachable.
note: IMPORTANT — the declared HS code 847130 (portable ADP machines/laptops) is NOT what the customs records show. The observed import lines are HS 85411000 (diodes/semiconductors), 85249190 (LCD modules), 85189000 (microphone parts) and 85182190 (loudspeakers) — automotive electronics and audio components. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: company stays in the database, HS should be corrected to the actual traded codes (85411000 / 85182190 / 85249190 / 85189000), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. On rule 5: the 80,396 records prove this entity is a large, active IMPORTER into India (latest record dated 2026-02-28, 407 trading partners, 144 ports), but they are not evidence of export shipments — no outbound B/L with an Indian origin and foreign destination was found, so export_status is none_found, not confirmed. Note also that the ImportKey address is 'NO.301, 3B CAMPUS, 3RD FLOOR, RMZ ECOSPACE, SARJAPURA ECOSPACE' (Bengaluru, Karnataka), which conflicts with the claimed state 'Delhi'; the Delhi link likely comes from the original 1996 incorporation. Domestic supply evidence could not be obtained because all four financial/GST aggregators blocked access (403) — this is a gap in verification, not a finding of no supplies. Revenue and export volume: null, not public in reachable sources; no figures invented. Search tooling (DuckDuckGo/searx) was down for the whole session, so slug variants and second sources were reached by direct URL only.
